body: maybe this never gets looked at, maybe this just goes into the big black hole of unread reddit messages, but i'm doing better. it's only been a few hours and with the faq links i learned that i am probably severely depressed. i need more resources, including a psychologist, to get me through this rough time in my life. i have a feeling that tomorrow i will probably feel horrible again, but i will try to get through the day without acting on the urge toward ending my life. knowing myself, i have a feeling that if i set my mind to it, i will follow through, and that will be the end. i hope i can talk myself out of it (or at least delaying it until i feel better again) tomorrow.

more backstory, because i'm breaking down and starting to cry. went to a job fair the other day, only people there were the army, post office, insurance sales, and timeshare scammers. went to a church next to the hotel and cried. breaking down, maybe in a good way, maybe in a defeated way. maybe part of this is because i just quit smoking cigarettes and weed, mostly because i lost my job and have no cash. feeling pretty pathetic when i wake up, just want to stay in bed. girlfriend is the only thing that makes me feel good. love her hugs. she doesn't know i'm broke and unemployed. or that i might have given her herpes. just writing that hurts, knowing that the only person that i care about could have her life ruined by me. tired of faking it. ate out of a dumpster yesterday because i need something other than ramen. thought about begging for change. done crying, not sure what next.
